subject.title: fix(plugins): run message_sending on all channel agent-reply deliveries (#92374)

question: Should this PR remain the canonical comprehensive repair for the configured-dispatcher and Telegram streamed-final `message_sending` bypass after the suffix re-entry bug is fixed?
rationale: The code defect is concrete, but the permanent ownership boundary for pre-send safety hooks and whether to land the comprehensive branch or split the fix needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair Comprehensive Branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the canonical branch, fix suffix hook re-entry, rebase it, and require refreshed Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Split Dispatcher First
options.body: Land a narrower dispatcher-only fix such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92976 and keep Telegram streamed-final coverage on the canonical issue.

options.title: Ask For Replacement
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers want a smaller owner-authored replacement that covers both paths without the current draft/conflict/proof blockers.

recommendation.title: Repair Comprehensive Branch
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the canonical branch, fix suffix hook re-entry, rebase it, and require refreshed Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame routes the live dispatcher and Telegram lines to this recent area contributor, though the checkout is shallow so the confidence is limited.
